name: jsettlers-retest-served
purpose: Re-test of the JSettlers table for the planner_pv2_tiles promotion: planner_offer_accept alone vs three all-SMART JSettlers 2.6.10 robots on seeded games (base seed 20261114, 2048 games), paired by game name with the other policy's run (experiments/tiles-retest.json).
analysis: Paired with the other policy's receipt by scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.0125 --expect-games 2048 (see experiments/tiles-retest.json).
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any re-test game. Same server settings, patch v2, all-SMART robots as jsettlers-heldout-*; fresh base seed 20261114 (not used by any earlier run); 2048 games; only the policy differs between the pair.
